resolved_intents.intent: Verify edit feedback screen is visible
Get tell your experience text value

missing_methods.intent: Assert tell your experience text is truncated
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: This method should verify that the text entered in the 'tell your experience' field is truncated to the maximum allowed characters. It should: 1) Get the current text value from the feedback text field using get_entered_text(), 2) Get the character count using get_feedback_text_char_count(), 3) Parse the character count to extract current and maximum values, 4) Assert that the current character count equals the maximum allowed characters, 5) Assert that the length of the entered text does not exceed the maximum characters, 6) Return True if truncation is correctly enforced, False otherwise.
implementation_checklist: Wait for 'edit_feedback' to be present using self.driver.wait_for_object('edit_feedback')
Call existing method self.get_entered_text() to retrieve the current text value from the feedback text field
Store the retrieved text in a variable (e.g., entered_text)
Calculate the actual length of the entered text using len(entered_text)
Wait for 'edit_feedback_char_count' to be present using self.driver.wait_for_object('edit_feedback_char_count')
Call existing method self.get_feedback_text_char_count() to retrieve the character count display text
Store the character count text in a variable (e.g., char_count_text)
Parse the char_count_text to extract the current character count (e.g., extract '2000' from '2000/2000' format)
Parse the char_count_text to extract the maximum character count (e.g., extract '2000' from '2000/2000' format)
Assert that the parsed current character count equals the max_characters parameter
Assert that the actual length of entered_text (from step 4) equals the max_characters parameter
Assert that the actual length of entered_text does not exceed the max_characters parameter
Assert that the parsed current character count equals the parsed maximum character count
Return True if all assertions pass, otherwise return False or raise AssertionError with descriptive message
